quote: I don't seem to understand what you mean by that.
stewart_read: Reasonable clarifying question, appropriate opening move on a technical topic outside core script.
coaching_implication: Fine as a first move; sets up the rep to actually answer rather than guess.

quote: That's a good question. So, like I said, I honestly wouldn't know.
stewart_read: Rep admits the limit of his knowledge honestly rather than fabricating, but doesn't bridge to the specialist here — he keeps trying to explain for two more minutes.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive: rep should have redirected to Tate/specialist right here instead of at 07:36, saving 3+ minutes of repeated explanation.
coaching_implication: When admitting 'I honestly wouldn't know,' that is the exact moment to bridge to the specialist, not to keep guessing.

stewart_read: Customer signals the explanation only partly landed; rep restates nearly the same line instead of trying a different angle.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic read considered: rep may have believed one more restatement would land — not well supported since he repeats near-verbatim rather than reframing.
coaching_implication: A second explanation attempt should change the angle (e.g. concrete kWh example), not restate the same logic in different words.

quote: ComEd doesn't have a 100% buyback rate. Have you considered looking into a battery backup system
stewart_read: Rep pivots the customer's own production complaint into a battery-backup pitch, using the utility's imperfect buyback as the villain — a genuine inversion move.
coaching_implication: This is the strongest moment in the call — it should have come sooner, right after the first 'I honestly wouldn't know' at 03:37.

quote: Kate is the one that originally helped you out get the solar system. He could actually give you a callback
stewart_read: Rep correctly redirects to the closer-tier specialist (misheard as 'Kate'/'Tate') to actually spec the battery, rather than continuing to sell it himself.
coaching_implication: Good scope discipline once triggered — should be the template for handling technical questions floor-wide.

quote: Is there a good time Tuesday that would work for you for him to give you a call
stewart_read: Rep locks a specific day and later a specific time (11AM), completing the booking beat cleanly.
coaching_implication: Good close; missing pieces are the one-hour-block and no-driving/computer button-up elements, and no 'is that fair' handshake.
